name: FA_DEPRN_TAX_REP_T
description: FA_DEPRN_TAX_REP_T is the Depreciable Assets Tax Reports interim table.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: ASSET_ID
columns.description: Identification number of the asset.

columns.name: CATEGORY_ID
columns.description: Category identifier for the asset.

columns.name: BOOK_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Asset book type identification code.

columns.name: MINOR_CATEGORY
columns.description: Minor category value for the asset type.

columns.name: STATE
columns.description: State value of location flexfield.

columns.name: START_UNITS_ASSIGNED
columns.description: Units assigned at start date used in asset tax report.

columns.name: END_UNITS_ASSIGNED
columns.description: Units assigned at end date used in asset tax report.

columns.name: START_COST
columns.description: Asset cost at depreciation start date.

columns.name: END_COST
columns.description: Asset cost at depreciation end date.

columns.name: INCREASE_COST
columns.description: Cost increase for a year used in asset tax report.

columns.name: DECREASE_COST
columns.description: Cost decrease for a year used in asset tax report.

columns.name: THEORETICAL_NBV
columns.description: Theoretical NBV calculation of the asset.

columns.name: EVALUATED_NBV
columns.description: Evaluated NBV calculation of the asset.

columns.name: ERA_NAME_NUM
columns.description: Name of the era for the date the asset is placed in service. The Japanese era calendar scheme is a common calendar scheme used in Japan, which identifies a year by the combination of the Japanese era name and the year number within the era.

columns.name: ADD_ERA_YEAR
columns.description: Year of the era for the date the asset is placed in service. The Japanese era calendar scheme is a common calendar scheme used in Japan, which identifies a year by the combination of the Japanese era name and the year number within the era.

columns.name: ADD_MONTH
columns.description: Month of date placed in service.

columns.name: START_LIFE
columns.description: Asset life at depreciation start date.

columns.name: END_LIFE
columns.description: Asset life at depreciation end date.

columns.name: THEORETICAL_RESIDUAL_RATE
columns.description: Theoretical residual rate of the asset.

columns.name: EVALUATED_RESIDUAL_RATE
columns.description: Evaluated residual rate of the asset.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_CODE
columns.description: Exception code for a tax exception in the asset tax report.

columns.name: EXCEPTION_RATE
columns.description: Exception rate for a tax exception in the asset tax report.

columns.name: THEORETICAL_TAXABLE_COST
columns.description: Taxable standard cost for theoretical NBV.

columns.name: EVALUATED_TAXABLE_COST
columns.description: Taxable standard cost for evaluated NBV.

columns.name: ALL_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason code for detail report that lists all asset types. Possible values are 1 for new asset, 2 for used asset, 3 for transfer in, and 4 for other.

columns.name: ALL_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for detail report that lists all asset types.

columns.name: ADD_DEC_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates which report is using the current record. Possible values are A for the additions report, D for the decreases report, and blank for others.

columns.name: ADDDEC_REASON_CODE
columns.description: Reason code for detail report that lists additions in assets or decreases in assets. For additions, possible values are 1 for new addition, 2 for used addition, 3 for transfer in, and 4 for other. For decreases, possible values are 1 for sale, 2 for retirement, 3 for transfer out, and 4 for other.

columns.name: ADDDEC_DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for detail report that lists the additions in assets or decreases in assets.

columns.name: DEC_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Decrease type for detail report that lists the decreases in assets. Possible values are 1 for all and 2 for partial.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
